sentences.text: RedGet.io is a cohort company whose country is recorded as BG, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The only dated record is a programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site, dated 2026-02-09.
No business or investment evidence is on file, so those levels are unknown.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and more public evidence on ocean impact, business and investment readiness is needed.
